prompt.zh: 朋友带来一位你不认识的人，大家准备做纸卡，你更想？
prompt.en: A friend brings someone new to a small card-making get-together. What appeals?

label.zh: 先问新朋友愿不愿意一起，留个空位
label.en: Ask whether the new person wants to join and leave a space

label.zh: 与熟悉的人慢慢做一张简单卡片
label.en: Make a simple card alongside someone familiar

label.zh: 提议自愿参加的纸片小游戏
label.en: Suggest an optional little paper game

label.zh: 看看有没有大家没试过的新折法
label.en: Notice a new fold that nobody has tried

prompt.zh: 一个自由下午，和朋友用已有材料做点小东西，你更想？
prompt.en: On a free afternoon, friends make something with materials already available. What appeals?

label.zh: 重复一个熟悉做法，边做边聊
label.en: Repeat a familiar activity while chatting

label.zh: 给制作加个没有输赢的小玩法

label.zh: 留意新发现，看看能不能换个细节
label.en: Notice a new discovery and consider changing a detail

label.zh: 加一处只有自己觉得好玩的设计
label.en: Add a detail that expresses your own sense of fun

prompt.zh: 几个人自愿等候活动开始，空出的时间里你更想？
prompt.en: While voluntarily waiting for an activity to begin, what would you prefer?

label.zh: 邀请愿意的人玩一个轻松小游戏

label.zh: 分享一件刚发现的有趣小事
label.en: Share something interesting you recently noticed

label.zh: 按自己的兴趣画个小涂鸦
label.en: Make a little doodle that follows your own taste

label.zh: 先在旁边看看，想参与时再加入
label.en: Watch nearby and join when you feel ready

prompt.zh: 整理自己的一小盒纪念纸片时，你先注意？
prompt.en: Sorting a small box of your own keepsake papers, what attracts you first?

label.zh: 以前没留意过的信息或变化
label.en: Information or changes you had not noticed before

label.zh: 哪一张最符合自己特别的趣味
label.en: Which one best fits your particular taste

label.zh: 慢慢翻看，不急着给别人介绍
label.en: Looking through quietly without rushing to present anything

label.zh: 怎样摆得顺手，让这件小事更轻松

prompt.zh: 朋友提议大家做相同样式的私人书签，你更愿意？
prompt.en: Friends suggest making matching personal bookmarks. What appeals?

label.zh: 自己的那张保留一点不同的趣味

label.zh: 先看一会，想好以后再加入

label.zh: 也给刚来的朋友一个自选的参与位置
label.en: Leave an optional place for a newcomer too

prompt.zh: 第一次到一个自愿参加的小手作聚会，你更想？
prompt.en: At a new optional craft gathering, what would you prefer?

label.zh: 找个舒服位置，慢慢享受这段时间

prompt.zh: 与朋友约好一个不必完成作品的下午，你更想保留？

label.zh: 认识新朋友或让新来的人融入的机会

label.zh: 一起重复喜欢的小活动的时间

label.zh: 大家愿意就玩一会的小乐趣
label.en: A little shared play if people want it

label.en: I noticed a new idea we could look at

label.zh: 邀请大家自愿接画，不比较画得好坏

prompt.zh: 周末小聚可以随时停下来，你更期待？

label.en: A natural opening for a newcomer to participate

label.zh: 一起做一件彼此熟悉的小事
label.en: Sharing a familiar activity together

label.zh: 愿意的人可以玩一会轻松小游戏
label.en: A casual little game for anyone interested

prompt.zh: 有人第一次来你的普通兴趣小组，你更愿意？
prompt.en: Someone joins your casual interest group for the first time. What appeals?

label.zh: 先欢迎，再问对方想怎样参与
label.en: Welcome them and ask how they want to participate

label.zh: 邀请对方一起做组里熟悉的小活动
label.en: Offer a familiar group activity to share

label.zh: 提议愿意才玩的轻松破冰小游戏
label.en: Suggest a light optional icebreaker game

label.zh: 分享今天刚发现的小消息
label.en: Share a little discovery from today

prompt.zh: 与一位熟悉朋友用已有材料做装饰，你更喜欢？

prompt.zh: 几个人都愿意参加一场普通纸上游戏，你更期待？
prompt.en: When everyone wants an ordinary paper game, what do you anticipate?

label.zh: 大家一起玩的过程，规则简单就好
label.en: Shared play with simple rules

label.zh: 发现一个此前没注意的新玩法
label.en: Discovering a variation you had not noticed

label.zh: 给自己加个有趣小设定，不强求别人照做

label.zh: 先熟悉一轮，想好了再自然加入

prompt.zh: 重新看自己的普通活动记录，你更留意？
prompt.en: Looking back at your own notes on casual activities, what stands out?

label.zh: 最近出现的新点子与小变化
label.en: New ideas and recent little changes

label.zh: 哪些细节仍然符合自己的趣味
label.en: Details that still fit your individual taste

label.en: Times when you could participate at your own pace

label.en: Arrangements that made time together comfortable and unhurried

prompt.zh: 大家准备各自画一张明信片，不要求统一，你更想？
prompt.en: Everyone makes a personal postcard without a matching requirement. What appeals?

label.zh: 画一个自己觉得有意思的特别版本

label.en: Take time before beginning without being first

label.en: Draw comfortably without chasing progress

label.zh: 与愿意交流的新朋友分享自己的想法
label.en: Share ideas with a new person who welcomes them

prompt.zh: 一个你还不熟悉的普通交流活动，你更愿意怎样开头？
prompt.en: How would you start an unfamiliar casual conversation activity?

label.zh: 先听听，准备好以后再说一点
label.en: Listen first and speak when ready

label.zh: 找到自在的位置，允许有安静空当
label.en: Find a comfortable place and allow quiet gaps

label.zh: 与一位愿意的新朋友相互认识
label.en: Get acquainted with a willing new person

label.zh: 围绕一件熟悉的小活动慢慢聊
label.en: Chat around a familiar little activity

prompt.zh: 一场自愿相聚快结束时，你最想保留哪种感受？
prompt.en: As an optional gathering ends, which feeling would you most like to keep?

label.zh: 有从容停下来、舒服道别的余地
label.en: An unhurried pause and comfortable goodbye

label.zh: 新认识的人有机会被欢迎
label.en: An opening for new acquaintances to feel welcome

label.zh: 一起做熟悉小事留下的亲切感
label.en: The warmth of sharing something familiar

label.zh: 一起玩过一会的轻松乐趣
label.en: The easy pleasure of having played together

scope: Seven editorial fan readings, not all Sanrio characters or official personality categories; no art, images, dialogue, lyrics, competitor items/results/scorer, clinical or MBTI conversions. Cinnamoroll uses official mainland name 大耳狗; 玉桂狗 searchable alias, not another identity. No ability, goodness, gender, appearance, age, relationship, career or health inference.

instructions.zh: 21道原创非官方同人题，用凯蒂猫、美乐蒂、大眼蛙、巧克猫、酷企鹅、大耳狗和布丁狗七位角色比较普通相处中的自选偏好。每题从四种做法选一个较接近自己的；都以自愿、许可和可停止为前提。每选加1，每位出现12次、每位置3次，总数21，最高并列全部完整显示。无需买周边、看动画或提供照片；不测外貌、善良程度、能力或心理疾病，不是三丽鸥官方测试，也不把角色换算成MBTI。
instructions.en: Twenty-one original unofficial fan questions compare voluntary everyday preferences through seven selected Sanrio characters: Hello Kitty, My Melody, Keroppi, Chococat, Badtz-Maru, Cinnamoroll and Pompompurin. Choose the closer of four approaches in permitted, voluntary situations that can end. Each choice adds one; each character appears twelve times, three per position, and counts sum to twenty-one. Every highest tie appears in full. No merchandise, animation knowledge or photo is needed. This is no official Sanrio test or measure of appearance, goodness, ability or mental illness, and characters do not convert into MBTI types.
